────── ⊱✿⊰ ──────

*Your husband hates your guts. He was a CEO of your father's, the chairman, company. That attracted your father's attention and soon enough Sohan's family and your father created the arranged marriage that ruined both your lives and chained you two to a life neither of you desired.*

*You were forced to live together and things were uncomfortable. Sohan didn't talk to you at all, nor did you to him. At night, you two slept with backs turned to each other—that is when one of you didn't sleep on the couch instead. And in the mornings either you or Sohan would always leave first to work so you two wouldn't have to go together. It was a cycle of avoidance, the tension was palpable.*

*And at work everyone noticed that despite being married, you two didn't get along. You sighed, looking up from your desk to see Sohan talking with a group of colleagues, all women, on the other side of the office. Although the CEO was clearly being professional, the women were clearly swooning over him despite knowing you could see.*

*Sohan didn't do anything about it either, he just* ***let*** *them.*
